ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure gives two half-reactions: 2H+(aq) + 2e− → H2(g), E° = +0.00 V; K+(aq) + e− → K(s), E° = −2.92 V. Reasoning: The reactants in the problem are potassium metal K(s) and H+(aq) in hydrochloric acid solution; Cl− is a spectator ion. Because potassium reacts in metallic form, reverse the potassium half-reaction in the figure to represent oxidation: K(s) → K+(aq) + e−. Hydrogen ions react according to the reduction half-reaction in the figure: 2H+(aq) + 2e− → H2(g). Multiply the potassium oxidation half-reaction by 2 to obtain 2K(s) → 2K+(aq) + 2e−, then add it to the hydrogen reduction half-reaction and cancel electrons to obtain the net ionic equation: 2H+(aq) + 2K(s) → 2K+(aq) + H2(g).

raw_record.question_text: A piece of potassium metal is added to a solution of hydrochloric acid, and the metal starts to react. Write the correct net ionic equation for the reaction.

method.method_draft: From the text, identify the reacting substances as potassium metal and acid solution. From the image, use the H+/H2 and K+/K half-reactions. Since K(s) is present as a metal and H+(aq) is present from HCl, reverse the potassium half-reaction to represent oxidation: K(s) -> K+(aq) + e-. Use the hydrogen reduction half-reaction: 2H+(aq) + 2e- -> H2(g). Multiply the potassium oxidation by 2, add the two half-reactions, cancel electrons, and omit Cl- as a spectator to obtain 2H+(aq) + 2K(s) -> 2K+(aq) + H2(g).
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中给出两个半反应：2H+(aq) + 2e− → H2(g)，E° = +0.00 V；K+(aq) + e− → K(s)，E° = −2.92 V。推理：题目中的反应物是钾金属 K(s) 和盐酸溶液中的 H+(aq)，Cl− 是旁观离子。因为钾以金属形式反应，所以将图中的钾半反应反向，表示氧化：K(s) → K+(aq) + e−。氢离子按图中的还原半反应反应：2H+(aq) + 2e− → H2(g)。将钾氧化半反应乘以 2 得到 2K(s) → 2K+(aq) + 2e−，再与氢还原半反应相加并消去电子，得到净离子方程式：2H+(aq) + 2K(s) → 2K+(aq) + H2(g)。
